ProgramUnit.Name: DO_UPDATIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_updations IS
BEGIN
 begin
 update components
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse, 
 component_status = 'L',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into product_history
 ( unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, aliquot,
 product_code, status_ind, from_date, user_id,
 blood_type, program_id)
 select unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, aliquot,
 product_code, 'IL', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, blood_type, :banner.prog_name
 from active_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code ; --and HCL
 -- aliquot = 1;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into product_history');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from active_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in deleting from active_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into component_attributes
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 product_code, attrib_group, attrib_code,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :product_code, 'ALERT', 'CP6I', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 from dual
 where 0 = (select count(*)
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 attrib_group = 'ALERT' and
 attrib_code = 'CP6I');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in unit_attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if; 
END;

PROCEDURE CALL_SRVDON (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_aliquot in varchar2)

IS
 ret_val varchar2(5); 
BEGIN
 ret_val := SRVDON.donor_acceptable(p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 p_aliquot,
 FALSE);
 IF ret_val = 'FALSE' THEN
 show_error('9911');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'NOREG' THEN
 show_error('9912');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'NODON' THEN
 show_error('9913');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'HOLD' THEN
 show_error('9914');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'QUAR' THEN
 show_error('9915');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'UNKN' THEN
 show_error('9916');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'RTNDF' THEN
 show_error('9917');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'INTST' THEN
 show_error('9918');
 ELSIF ret_val = 'DHOLD' THEN
 show_error('9919');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INTER_AFTER_LABEL_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_inter_after_label_local(unit in VARCHAR2, cdate in date,
 pcode in VARCHAR2, alq in varchar2) is
/* This procedure is replaced by new one on 02/10/2015. For old code, check previous version in TFS. */

 temp_count number;
 temp_label_dats date;
 temp_label_dats_max date;
 temp_label varchar(4);
 temp_v_chapter_id varchar2(5) := name_in('global.chapter_id');
 temp_v_code_scheme varchar2(1) := name_in ('global.code_scheme'); 
 prod_inter NUMBER:=0;
 unit_inter NUMBER:=0;
 nExists NUMBER:=0;
 p_coll_date Date;
 l_cnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 begin
 /* 
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-100000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = unit and
 --coll_date = cdate and
 product_code = pcode and
 component_prefix = alq and
 component_status = 'L';
 --and chapter_id = temp_v_chapter_id ;
 */ 

 /* below analytical function can not be used in forms, so below ueries are used to implement the same functionality.
 -- Below query without rownum=1 will return rows where label_dats is equal to max(label_dats) for that unit ID. This may return multiple rows, so added ROWNUM=1;
 SELECT NVL(label_dats,sysdate-100000), component_status
 FROM (
 SELECT label_dats, component_status, MAX(NVL(label_dats,sysdate-100000)) OVER (partition BY unit_id) label_dats_max
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = unit and
 product_code = pcode and
 component_prefix = alq
 )
 WHERE NVL(label_dats,sysdate-100000) = label_dats_max
 AND ROWNUM = 1; 
 */ 
 
 select COUNT(1) 
 into l_cnt
 from components
 where unit_id = unit and
 --coll_date = cdate and
 product_code = pcode; -- and
 --component_prefix = alq; --MLT- ( commented out ,this works only for ISBT and does not work for codabar)
 
 
 IF l_cnt = 1 THEN
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-100000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = unit and
 --coll_date = cdate and
 product_code = pcode; -- and
 --component_prefix = alq; 
 ELSE
 -- Get the MAX of label_dats value.
 select MAX(nvl(label_dats,sysdate-100000))
 into temp_label_dats_max
 from components
 where unit_id = unit and
 --coll_date = cdate and
 product_code = pcode; -- and
 --component_prefix = alq;
 
 -- Get the record that has maximum label_dats value - added rownum =1 to get only one record.
 SELECT label_dats, system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = unit and
 --coll_date = cdate and
 product_code = pcode --and
 --component_prefix = alq and
 and nvl(label_dats,sysdate-100000)= temp_label_dats_max and
 ROWNUM = 1;
 END IF; 

 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 -- check for component interdictions
 begin
 select count(*) into prod_inter
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = unit
 --and coll_date = cdate
 and product_code = pcode
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 
 
 /* if prod_inter > 0 then
 show_error('0031'); -- component interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 */
 
 
 if prod_inter >= 1 then
 if substr(:GLOBAL.ENTRY_MODE,1,1) ='S' THEN
 show_error('9791'); 
 else
 show_error('9796');
 end if; 
 end if; 

 end;
 
 -- check for unit interdictions
 begin
 select count(*) into unit_inter
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where unit_id = unit
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and ( ((vi.inter_type != 'B' or temp_label not in ('40','71'))
 AND temp_v_code_scheme = 'C')
 or (not exists ( SELECT 'X' 
 FROM vserv_abo
 WHERE abo_code = temp_label
 AND identifier_code in ('AB','DB','EM')
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I')
 AND temp_v_code_scheme = 'I') )
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) -- 6945
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y'
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 
 /* if unit_inter > 0 then
 show_error('0184'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 */
 
 
 if unit_inter >= 1 then
 if substr(:GLOBAL.ENTRY_MODE,1,1) ='S' THEN
 show_error('9791'); 
 else
 show_error('9796');
 end if; 
 end if; 
 
 end;
 
EXCEPTION
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.trigger_record = 1
 then
 clear_record;
 else
 clear_record;
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--global var is used in trigger key-nxt-item trigger of unit_id and product_code fields
 erase('global.cur_field');
 clear_form(NO_VALIDATE,FULL_ROLLBACK);
 exit_form;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-PREV-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_value is not null
 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 PREVIOUS_ITEM;
end;
